title: Figure 13: Idea for a Cloaking Device for Visible Light – cylindrical cloak, nanowires
description: Two-part technical illustration. Panel a shows the coordinate transformation of a solid pink cylinder of radius b into a cylindrical shell with radii a and b, with x, y, z and r axes. Panel b shows a wedge-shaped section of the cloak labeled "Dielectric host" and "Metal wires," with radii r1 and r2. The caption reads "Figure 13. Idea for a Cloaking Device for Visible Light. Metal nanowires replace the split-ring resonators of the microwave cloaking device."
